excludes.reason: COSMIC and HGMD-PUBLIC identifiers are not redistributed; the input records are chosen so that variant_recoder co-locates none of them, and the cache slice carries none

inputs.variants.id.txt: nine identifier lines: eight variants of the GRCh38-input-id corpus, the ones neither failed in dbSNP nor co-located with a COSMIC or HGMD-PUBLIC variant, one of them spelled in upper case as well
inputs.variants.hgvs.txt: the same variants as HGVS notations: every genomic (g.) notation on the NC_000021.9 accession, one on the chromosome's own name, one transcript (c.) notation for every variant but the multi-allelic indel, on the MANE Select transcript where the variant has one, and the protein (p.) notations of the missense variant's two alleles; the deletion allele of the multi-allelic indel is written only as part of its identifier and VCF record, since variant_recoder attaches a multi-allelic known variant's identifier to an unmatched allele through the minimised form of its last alternate alone and so gives that allele none on its own
inputs.variants.spdi.txt: the same variants as SPDI notations on the NC_000021.9 accession, one on the chromosome's own name, the multi-allelic indel's deletion allele left out as in variants.hgvs.txt
inputs.variants.recode.vcf: the same variants as VCF records, each with its identifier in the ID column
inputs.json_cache: the GRCh38-input-id corpus's transcripts with a variation slice of every row of the Ensembl GRCh38 cache starting within 2,000 bases of a record of this corpus or of the GRCh38-input-id corpus, the excluded identifiers left out, so the co-located variants a database-backed variant_recoder finds by span are in the cache
inputs.reference.fa.gz: GRCh38 chromosome 21 with every base outside 2,000 bases of a record of this corpus or of the GRCh38-input-id corpus masked to N, bgzip-compressed, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form
inputs.chr_synonyms.txt: the six lines of the Ensembl GRCh38 cache's chr_synonyms.txt that link chromosome 21's names (21, chr21, NC_000021.9, CM000683.2) to one another, read with --synonyms so HGVSg, SPDI and the GA4GH VRS allele name the chromosome by its accession
